layers.authority: Sivil Havacılık Genel Müdürlüğü (SHGM, Turkish civil aviation authority)
layers.process: Commercial hot air balloon flights over the Nevşehir Cappadocia balloon flight area run on a slot system. SHGM sets a maximum number of balloons flying at once for the morning and for the afternoon, and each licensed operator has its own slot allocation per period. Operators file flight plans with the Slot Service Centre, which gives departure approval only if the slots are not exceeded, and weather is judged by sector. A visitor does not apply for anything; it means flights by licensed operators only, and a flight can be held or cancelled on the day. The instruction has been revised several times (Rev. 04 dated 10 April 2020 is the version read), so the current numbers should be confirmed with the operator.

laws.rule: Under Nevşehir Governor's General Order 2 of 11 July 2025, knives and other cutting, piercing or blunt instruments that fall outside Law 6136 may not be carried on the person in parks, squares, streets, school surroundings, markets, shopping centres, public rest and entertainment places, cafes, official buildings, hospitals, public transport, club premises, rallies and sports venues in Nevşehir province. Sale or display outside licensed premises is also banned, and sale to or carrying by under-18s is banned. Such items may be transported only if wrapped and packed in luggage or in a vehicle boot or glove box so they cannot be used at short notice. Tools needed for a trade may be used at the place of work by the people doing that work. Breaches that are not a separate crime attract the administrative fine in article 32 of the Misdemeanours Law (Kabahatler Kanunu). The order took effect on publication, 11 July 2025.
